title: P.A.I.M.O.N
description: This mod add PAIMON, just Paimon (and a op totem).
body: This mod add just Paimon, and a OP totem. You can easily unlock the craft, if you found some bugs, report them to me in the comment. The crafts are a little bit ... expansive. You can tame Paimon with every edible food in the game, like in genshin. The Paimon totem is so OP that even a /kill can't kill you! There is a Paimon spawn egg too. There isn't any purpose, the mod just add an invicible Paimon just here in your world.
